original_sentence: But contrary to all the self-proclaimed success experts, doing it alone does not make you more successful or any better than someone who achieved it with the help of others.
translation: 但是，与所有自封的成功专家所说相反，独自完成这件事并不会让你比那些在他人帮助下成功的人更成功或更优秀。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: with the help of others 在本句中对应"在他人帮助下"。
doing it alone 在本句中对应"独自完成"。
contrary to 在本句中对应"与……相反"。
self-proclaimed 在本句中对应"自封的"。
